sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present Kimi-VL, an efficient open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model (VLM) that offers advanced multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, and strong agent capabilities —all while activating only 2.8B parameters in its language decoder (Kimi-VL-A3B).
